artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: seven phases, verification results, and plan deviations.
Rewritten bimodal certificate printer with certificate-derived witnesses and the align_vertically table.
Shared use_colors(output) predicate (NO_COLOR > FORCE_COLOR > TERM=dumb > isatty).

completion_data.completion_summary: Rewrote the bimodal countermodel presentation: user-notation formulas, a certificate-derived box witness (fixing the wrong registry-index witness line), a role column, a Search bounds header, one Verification line, ^ω/∅ glyphs with cp1252 fallbacks, a live -a time-aligned table, user-notation iteration diffs, and one systemic shared use_colors predicate so pipes and NO_COLOR get plain text. Full suite 3416 passed.

memory_candidates.content: A grep for `output is sys.__stdout__` is not a complete inventory of ANSI escape sources: printers also use `is sys.stdout`, unconditional `\033[` literals, and `self.COLORS` dicts. Verify color gating with a live `dev_cli.py ... | cat -v | grep -c '^['` pipe check per theory, including an `iterate: N` example, since the runner calls the structure's `print_model_differences`, not the iterator's display method.

When rendering bimodal closure formulas, invert `translate` over `Syntax.all_sentences` first (first-seen wins); every boxed closure member is a named sentence or derived subsentence (e.g. `\Diamond A` records `\Box \neg A`), so the structural glyph fallback only appears for iteration-diff label bits. Dataclass reprs must stay untouched because `witness_registry.py` builds Z3 variable names from them.

`WitnessRegistry._witness_lassos` is reserved capacity, not provenance: box faithfulness lets any lasso falsify a box, so a printed witness must be computed by scanning `certificate.lassos` x `_box_window` for a position whose label omits the child (the C3 predicate).

reflection.what_worked: Closing one phase at a time with a scoped commit, and running a live dev_cli pipe check after each printer-affecting phase, caught every gap the unit tests could not (the runner's print_model_differences path, the -a warning, the iterate diff escapes).
reflection.what_was_hard: Regex-driven bulk edits to the imposition iterate display silently clobbered my own inserted constants and missed an import; a parallel pipe check with stderr suppressed hid the NameError until I re-ran with stderr visible.
reflection.what_was_missed: The plan's scope hypotheses undercounted color-gate sites and assumed the iterator's display method was on the live path; both surfaced only through live runs and are recorded as plan deviations.
reflection.successes: F1 (wrong witness line) fixed with certificate-derived witnesses; zero escapes on pipes for all four theories; 3416 tests green; -a flag live with no warnings; cp1252 legs clean.

next_steps: Review the regenerated README sample and the Printed Output Conventions section; consider flipping align_vertically's default after using the table view.
